name: Popup Widget Addon For Elementor by TechnoArray
author: Raman Mehta

sections.description:
Popup Widget Addon For Elementor enhances your Elementor experience by providing a customizable popup widget. Create and manage popups with advanced styling and behavior options to engage visitors and showcase content.

Features:
– Customizable popup content and design
– Options to trigger popups on button clicks
– Advanced styling and positioning controls
– Compatible with Elementor and Elementor Pro
– Supports translation and localization
– User Can View Popup on elementor editor how its look like on frontend

sections.installation:
1. Upload the popup-widget-addon-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Elementor and find the Popup Widget in the Elementor widgets panel.
  4. Drag and drop the Popup Widget onto your page, and customize it using the available settings.
sections.faq:
How do I customize the popup appearance?

You can customize the popup’s appearance using the options available in the Elementor editor. Adjust settings such as color, size, and positioning to match your design preferences.
